movie.title: Ikiru
movie.overview: Kanji Watanabe is a middle-aged man who has worked in the same monotonous bureaucratic position for decades. Learning he has cancer, he starts to look for the meaning of his life.

facts: While Akira Kurosawa directed 'Ikiru,' its powerful screenplay was actually a collaborative effort, co-written with Shinobu Hashimoto and Hideo Oguni.
Did you know the film's poignant story was partly inspired by classic literature? Its screenplay drew from Leo Tolstoy's 1886 novella, 'The Death of Ivan Ilyich.'
The central figure of the film, the Tokyo bureaucrat on a quest for meaning, is specifically named Kanji Watanabe, whose decades of monotonous work define his starting point.
